name: Default Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.13-venv && rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m pip install git+https://github.com/brandon-benge/langchain_autocommit.git && npm install -g opencode-ai
